text:
mari: heads-up — support ticket #7842 from AcmeCorp. They've got a p95/p99 latency regression after we flipped the int8 quant profile for the latest llama-variant. Customers seeing 2x p99 and some 503s. Escalating. :warning:

ashok: thanks. do we have a clear rollout time? which cluster/region?

mari: rollout started 2025-11-06T21:10Z to hosted-us-west-2 (canary -> 100% over 30m). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate model=redwood-llama-v2-q8.

devon: pinging eng-runtime & infra. quick checks: any kernel failures, OOMs in pods, or expensive autograd traces?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary -> prod promotion successful (2025-11-06T21:40Z). No pod restarts recorded during promotion.

jin: shared a quick metric snapshot:
```
metric: inference_latency_ms
percentiles (window 10m) before rollout: p50=18 p95=82 p99=150
percentiles after rollout: p50=20 p95=190 p99=420
```

mari: customer traces show spikes correlate with requests that include long context (>=2048 tokens) and multi-turn chats.

ashok: that smells like a KV-cache/kv-copy inefficiency with int8 kernels. int8 path is using a different attention kernel that doesn't support the optimized KV store yet, so we fall back to a slower path for long sequences.

devon: can we repro locally? mari, any example payloads?

mari: pasted sample curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-v2-q8","input":"<~2k tokens lorem>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```

jin: tried repro on staging with same quant profile. Repro steps: 1) warm up with 50 short requests, 2) send 10 concurrent long-context requests. saw p99 ~ 380ms on a8g-4x. On fp16 variant p99 ~ 160ms.

mari: customer requesting immediate mitigation — can we route them to fp16 until we fix?

ashok: yes — quick mitigation: route tenant traffic to model=redwood-llama-v2-fp16, or flip the quant_profile flag per-tenant. But need to ensure capacity; fp16 uses ~1.9x GPU memory.

devon: recommend two-step mitigation: 1) enable per-tenant fallback to fp16 for AcmeCorp, 2) revert global rollout of q8 for that family (canary -> rollback). I'll prepare PR for rollback.

ops-bot: infra note: current pool for hosted-us-west-2 has 12 A8G nodes, ~65% utilized. If we move AcmeCorp to fp16 we'll likely bump to ~85%. Acceptable short-term.

jin: digging into profiler output. Key findings:
- int8 attention kernel picks a fallback path when sequence > 1024 due to tiled attention reshape.
- that fallback negates fused-kv streaming; we do an extra memcopy per layer.
- extra memcopy cost scales with layers (70 layers => large impact).

mari: any calibration issues during quantization? Could the calibration table cause extra ops?

jin: calibration itself is fine. The problem is a runtime conditional: if quant_profile.use_tiled_attention == true then call tiled_attention_int8(), else standard_attention(). The tiled path doesn't handle KV prefixing efficiently. In fp16 we use fused_kernel_attention() which does KV in-place.

ashok: so the bug is in runtime kernel selection for long context. Short contexts get the optimized int8 path and are fast, but long contexts trigger slow tiled path. That's why p50 looks fine and p95/p99 blow up.

devon: proposed permanent fixes: 1) add fallback to fp16-like fused-kv implementation for long-contexts on int8 path (costly to implement), or 2) change quant_profile selection to route long-context requests to fp16-optimized kernels automatically, or 3) improve tiled attention implementation to avoid extra memcopies.

mari: for now do the quick routing change + rollback rollout. I will open support case and offer AcmeCorp the fp16 fallback.

jin: created a canary rollback in infra: revert quant_profile feature flag for redwood-llama-v2-q8 in hosted-us-west-2 at 2025-11-07T00:05Z. After rollback metrics improved: p95=88 p99=170 (close to baseline).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag revert applied successfully.

devon: also pushed a short-term runtime patch: if sequence_length > 1024 and model_variant contains "q8" then route execution to fp16_compat_kernels. It's a stopgap with a toggle off by default.

ashok: good. Let's draft a formal action plan for permanent fix and QA matrix.

mari: customer update (sent): "we rolled back the q8 quantization for your region and routed you to a fp16-compatible path; latency should return to previous levels. We're investigating a long-context regression in the int8 tiled attention kernel and will follow up with a permanent fix and timeline." They replied :thumbsup: and said latency looks normal now.

jin: for the permanent fix items I propose:
- eng-ml: implement fused-kv attention for int8 or refactor tiled path to avoid memcopy (3 sprints)
- eng-runtime: add auto-routing policy based on seq_length and model_variant (1 sprint)
- QA: create synthetic grant tests with sequence-length sweep (512,1024,2048,4096) and concurrency sweep to validate p95/p99 across quant profiles (2 weeks)

devon: also add telemetry: per-model-path per-layer timing and memcopy counters so we can detect this earlier.

mari: final notes for ticket: repro steps, rollback time, mitigation applied, and contact points. I'll attach profiler snapshots.

support_bot: ticket #7842 updated: customer confirmed resolution. Closing pending postmortem.

ashok: thanks team. I'll own the follow-up RFC to change kernel selection heuristics.

mari: created a short postmortem draft in /confluence/ops/q8-long-context-regression (link shared in DM). TL;DR: rollout exposed long-context tiled-int8 fallback that regresses p95/p99 via extra memcopies; mitigated by rollback and seq-length routing. Action owners assigned.

devon: will schedule a cross-team sync (eng-ml + eng-runtime + infra) tomorrow to scope the implementation.

mari: marking this thread resolved. Thanks all :heart:
